cases.query: a function remembers items from previous calls because its default list is reused

top3.title: Mutable argument default leaks state across calls

where.summary: Function parameters with list, dict, set or another mutable default.
preconditions: The function mutates a default object and callers expect independent calls.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: Function parameters with list, dict, set or another mutable default.

how.mechanism: A default object is created at function definition and reused when the argument is omitted.
how.trigger_template: Call {function} with {first_input}, then {second_input}, omitting {parameter} both times.

what.observable_failure: The second call contains state left by the first call.
what.oracle_template: Under {contract}, compare the second result and side effects with a call using a fresh explicit default.

top3.title: A loop else executes after a successful search because no break occurs

where.summary: A search loop has an else clause but no relevant break.
preconditions: The else branch is intended only for a failed search.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: A search loop has an else clause but no relevant break.

how.mechanism: Loop else runs on normal exhaustion regardless of whether a match was encountered unless the loop exits with break.
how.trigger_template: Supply {items} containing a match for {predicate} and then allow normal exhaustion.

what.observable_failure: The not-found branch runs after successful processing.
what.oracle_template: Under {search_contract}, assert found and not-found effects are mutually correct for matching, missing and empty inputs.

top3.title: Loop target overwrites a value still needed elsewhere

where.summary: A loop target reuses an iterable name, enclosing loop variable, imported binding or parameter still needed elsewhere.
preconditions: Code later relies on the old binding.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: A loop target reuses an iterable name, enclosing loop variable, imported binding or parameter still needed elsewhere.

how.mechanism: for binds its target in the surrounding scope and each assignment replaces the previous value.
how.trigger_template: Use at least two {outer_values} and {inner_values}; read {reused_name} after the inner loop.

what.observable_failure: Later operations see a scalar or the inner iteration value instead of the intended object.
what.oracle_template: Under {contract}, assert the preserved iterable or outer-loop value is used at the later operation.

cases.query: lambda trong vòng lặp đều trả về giá trị cuối

top3.title: A generator return value is not an emitted item

where.summary: A function containing yield also returns a non-None value.
preconditions: A consumer expects that return value among ordinary iterated items.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: A function containing yield also returns a non-None value.

how.mechanism: return ends the generator; its value is carried by StopIteration rather than yielded.
how.trigger_template: Consume {generator} using list or a for loop, reaching its return path.

what.observable_failure: The expected terminal item is missing from the output sequence.
what.oracle_template: Under {contract}, compare emitted items with the required sequence; inspect StopIteration.value only if specified.

top3.title: Loop closures read the final binding instead of each iteration value

where.summary: A loop creates functions or lambdas that reference a loop variable.
preconditions: The callback is invoked after the variable has been rebound.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: A loop creates functions or lambdas that reference a loop variable.

how.mechanism: A closure reads a binding at call time instead of snapshotting its value at definition time.
how.trigger_template: Create callbacks for at least two distinct {loop_values}; invoke them after the loop.

what.observable_failure: Callbacks return the same final value or act on the wrong item.
what.oracle_template: Under {contract}, compare each callback result with the value from its own creation iteration.

top3.title: Definition-time call freezes a supposedly fresh value

where.summary: A function parameter default contains a function call.
preconditions: The default is expected to change with time, randomness or request context.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: A function parameter default contains a function call.

how.mechanism: The call runs once during definition, rather than once per invocation.
how.trigger_template: Invoke {function} before and after changing {external_state}, while omitting {parameter}.

what.observable_failure: Later invocations use an old timestamp, token or object.
what.oracle_template: Under {contract}, check that each invocation observes the required current state or a distinct object.

cases.query: checking whether a file is inside a directory using a text prefix lets a sibling directory pass

top3.title: A textual path prefix is mistaken for a common path component

where.summary: os.path.commonprefix is used for path ancestry or a shared-directory decision.
preconditions: The contract requires component boundaries or containment rather than character overlap.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: os.path.commonprefix is used for path ancestry or a shared-directory decision.

how.mechanism: commonprefix compares characters and can return a partial component shared by unrelated paths.
how.trigger_template: Use {paths} with a common spelling but different directory components, such as a directory name and a longer sibling name.

what.observable_failure: The computed ancestor is invalid or an unrelated sibling is classified as inside the required directory.
what.oracle_template: Under {path_contract}, assert component-aware ancestry under the required normalization and filesystem semantics.

top3.title: strip treats its argument as a character set rather than a substring

where.summary: strip, lstrip or rstrip receives a multi-character argument.
preconditions: The caller intends to remove an exact prefix or suffix.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: strip, lstrip or rstrip receives a multi-character argument.

how.mechanism: Each boundary character in the supplied set is removed repeatedly.
how.trigger_template: Use {text} whose boundary shares characters with {affix} without containing that exact affix.

what.observable_failure: Valid characters are removed or an unintended part of the text disappears.
what.oracle_template: Under {contract}, compare with the required exact prefix or suffix removal.

top3.title: A subprocess failure is mistaken for a successful operation

where.summary: subprocess.run is called without checking a nonzero return code.
preconditions: The enclosing operation requires the subprocess to succeed.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: subprocess.run is called without checking a nonzero return code.

how.mechanism: By default run returns a CompletedProcess even when the command exits unsuccessfully.
how.trigger_template: Run {command} with a controlled nonzero exit status and inspect the enclosing result.

what.observable_failure: The application reports success or consumes missing or invalid output.
what.oracle_template: Under {contract}, assert the specified failure signal or explicit returncode handling.

top3.title: Sequence indexing crosses the valid positive or negative boundary

where.summary: A sequence is indexed with a computed or hard-coded integer.
preconditions: The index is outside the sequence valid index range on that path.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: A sequence is indexed with a computed or hard-coded integer.

how.mechanism: Direct indexing rejects indices at or above length and below negative length instead of clamping like a slice.
how.trigger_template: Use {sequence} of length n and exercise {index_expression} at n, -n-1 and on an empty sequence.

what.observable_failure: IndexError replaces the required value or documented invalid-input handling.
what.oracle_template: Under {index_contract}, assert correct boundary values and the required rejection policy.

top3.title: A negative sentinel is accidentally used as a valid sequence index

where.summary: A search result or computed index can be negative before indexing a sequence.
preconditions: Negative results mean missing or invalid according to the application.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: A search result or computed index can be negative before indexing a sequence.

how.mechanism: Negative indexing selects from the end instead of rejecting the sentinel.
how.trigger_template: Choose {input} that produces index -1 and apply the resulting index to a nonempty {sequence}.

what.observable_failure: The last element is returned for a missing item.
what.oracle_template: Under {contract}, require explicit missing-item handling rather than returning the final element.

top3.title: A colon introduces an annotation instead of assigning a value

where.summary: A variable, attribute or subscription uses an annotation-like statement where assignment was intended.
preconditions: A later operation expects a value to have been stored.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: A variable, attribute or subscription uses an annotation-like statement where assignment was intended.

how.mechanism: Annotations describe a target and generally do not assign the intended runtime value.
how.trigger_template: Execute {annotation_statement}, then read {target} or inspect the original object.

what.observable_failure: The target is absent or retains its old value.
what.oracle_template: Under {contract}, assert that the required runtime assignment actually occurred.

top3.title: Mutation of a live iterable skips elements or raises

where.summary: A loop mutates the list, dictionary, set or live view it is traversing.
preconditions: Mutation affects remaining positions or collection size.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: A loop mutates the list, dictionary, set or live view it is traversing.

how.mechanism: List indices move as elements are removed; dict and set iteration may reject structural changes.
how.trigger_template: Iterate {container} with at least two adjacent removable items; mutate it during traversal.

what.observable_failure: Items are skipped, processed unexpectedly, or iteration raises RuntimeError.
what.oracle_template: Under {contract}, compare processed items and final contents against a traversal over a separate snapshot.

top3.title: An in-place container method result is mistaken for the container

where.summary: The result of list.sort, append, extend or another documented in-place mutator is assigned or returned.
preconditions: The caller expects the modified sequence as the method result.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: The result of list.sort, append, extend or another documented in-place mutator is assigned or returned.

how.mechanism: Many in-place container methods mutate their receiver and return None.
how.trigger_template: Run {mutator_call} on a nonempty sequence and inspect both its result and the original object.

what.observable_failure: A variable becomes None or a later operation on it fails.
what.oracle_template: Under {contract}, assert the required returned value separately from the required mutation.

top3.title: defaultdict keyword default_factory creates an entry instead of a factory

where.summary: defaultdict is initialized with default_factory as a keyword argument.
preconditions: Missing keys are expected to invoke that callable.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: defaultdict is initialized with default_factory as a keyword argument.

how.mechanism: The factory is positional-only; keyword arguments populate initial dictionary entries.
how.trigger_template: Create {mapping}, then access a distinct missing {key}.

what.observable_failure: The lookup raises KeyError and an unintended default_factory key exists.
what.oracle_template: Under {contract}, assert the intended default value, factory attribute and initial key set.

preconditions: The callback is invoked after the variable has been rebound.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: A loop creates functions or lambdas that reference a loop variable.

how.mechanism: A closure reads a binding at call time instead of snapshotting its value at definition time.
how.trigger_template: Create callbacks for at least two distinct {loop_values}; invoke them after the loop.

what.observable_failure: Callbacks return the same final value or act on the wrong item.

top3.title: finally return or jump overrides exceptions and return values

where.summary: A finally block contains return, break or continue.
preconditions: An earlier return value or exception must remain observable.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: A finally block contains return, break or continue.

how.mechanism: Control transfer in finally replaces pending control flow from try or except.
how.trigger_template: Make {try_body} raise {expected_exception} or return {expected_value}, then execute the finally jump.

what.observable_failure: The exception disappears or a different return value is observed.
what.oracle_template: Under {contract}, assert preservation of the required exception or return value after cleanup.

top3.title: Rebinding a parameter, receiver or assignment target destroys a still-needed value

where.summary: A parameter, receiver, definition or repeated destructuring target is rebound before a required use.
preconditions: Later behavior needs the earlier binding rather than the replacement.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: A parameter, receiver, definition or repeated destructuring target is rebound before a required use.

how.mechanism: Assignment and def statements replace the binding; repeated assignment targets retain the last stored value.
how.trigger_template: Use distinct {original_value} and {replacement_value}; execute {rebinding_site} and observe {later_use}.

what.observable_failure: A later call, attribute access or result uses the wrong object or value.
what.oracle_template: Under {binding_contract}, assert the expected original or replacement value at each required use.

top3.title: A special method returns a value forbidden by its protocol

where.summary: __bool__, __bytes__, __hash__, __index__, __len__ or __str__ returns an invalid type or length.
preconditions: The corresponding built-in operation invokes the special method.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: __bool__, __bytes__, __hash__, __index__, __len__ or __str__ returns an invalid type or length.

how.mechanism: Python enforces the return contract of each special method.
how.trigger_template: Call {builtin_operation} on {instance} whose special method returns {invalid_result}.

what.observable_failure: The built-in raises TypeError or ValueError rather than producing the required result.
what.oracle_template: Under {protocol_contract}, check the exact required return type and value domain for that method.

top3.title: An assertion message is mistaken for an expected comparison value

where.summary: An assertion uses a computed value as its condition and the expected literal as its message.
preconditions: The test intends exact equality rather than a truthiness test.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: An assertion uses a computed value as its condition and the expected literal as its message.

how.mechanism: assert actual, expected checks only actual truthiness and reserves expected for failure diagnostics.
how.trigger_template: Choose {actual_value} that is truthy but unequal to {expected_value}, then execute {assertion}.

what.observable_failure: The assertion passes despite a wrong value.
what.oracle_template: Under {value_contract}, assert the required equality or other comparison directly.

how.mechanism: commonprefix compares characters and can return a partial component shared by unrelated paths.
how.trigger_template: Use {paths} with a common spelling but different directory components, such as a directory name and a longer sibling name.

what.observable_failure: The computed ancestor is invalid or an unrelated sibling is classified as inside the required directory.

top3.title: Environment lookups violate key or fallback type assumptions

where.summary: os.getenv receives a non-string key or a fallback incompatible with downstream string handling.
preconditions: The selected key and present/missing environment cases reach the affected path.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: os.getenv receives a non-string key or a fallback incompatible with downstream string handling.

how.mechanism: Keys must be strings; a missing lookup can return its supplied default unchanged instead of an environment string.
how.trigger_template: Test {lookup_expression} with an invalid key and with a dedicated key both present and missing.

what.observable_failure: Lookup raises TypeError or downstream code receives an unexpected value type.
what.oracle_template: Under {environment_contract}, assert the key domain and the required present/missing return types.

top3.title: Rebinding os.environ breaks intended child environment propagation

where.summary: Code assigns a new object to os.environ.
preconditions: The goal is to change the actual process environment inherited by subprocesses.
where.location_template: At {location} in {target}, inspect: Code assigns a new object to os.environ.

how.mechanism: Replacing the Python mapping does not perform the underlying environment updates made through its original proxy.
how.trigger_template: Rebind {environment_mapping}, then start a controlled child process to inspect {test_variable}.

what.observable_failure: The child sees different environment values from the replacement mapping.
what.oracle_template: Under {environment_contract}, assert the child environment via an explicit env mapping or supported environment mutation.
